name: Wall Push-Up

instructions.description: Stand facing a wall with hands placed at chest height slightly wider than shoulder width.
Step your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall while keeping the body aligned.
Exhale and press away from the wall to return to the start.

performanceMetrics.notes: A low-load pressing option suitable for beginners or rehabilitation.

variations.variationDescription: Regression of the push-up using a more upright body angle.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Progress between wall and floor versions.

commentsNotes: Keep the body straight rather than bending at the hips.
Step farther from the wall to increase difficulty slightly.
